sloka: स ब्रह्मकोशं रजतालयं च शक्रालयं रुद्रशरप्रमोक्षम्।हयाननं ब्रह्मशिरश्च दीप्तं ददर्श वैवस्वतकिङ्करांश्च ।। ६.७४.५९ ।।
transliteration: sa brahmakośaṁ rajatālayaṁ ca śakrālayaṁ rudraśarapramokṣam।hayānanaṁ brahmaśiraśca dīptaṁ dadarśa vaivasvatakiṅkarāṁśca ।। 6.74.59 ।।

translations.english: He saw Vajralayam (where Brahma gave Indra the thunderbolt), the abode of Kubera shining like the Sun, the spot where the Sun was bound, Brahma's abode and the abode of the bow of Lord Siva, and the earth navel.
